messages:
sam: Quick watercooler thought  what if every coffee machine came with an LLM barista persona you could prompt? :coffee:  Ideas for names?

nina: CappuGPT. low-effort pun, high emotional support. :heart_eyes:

leo: we should have a hierarchy: Americano = Stoic Sage, Latte = Overly Friendly Mentor, Espresso = Tiny Energetic Intern.

marco: poll time: which persona would you want as your standup buddy? 1) Stoic Sage 2) Friendly Mentor 3) Energetic Intern 4) Passive-aggressive Cold Brew

sam: 2 (but it must compliment my commits)

nina: 4 (cold brew would gently remind you about your TODOs in haiku form)

leo: code snippet idea for the prompt:```
System: You are "BaristAI," a coffee shop LLM. When asked for a drink, return a 1-line greeting, the drink confirmation, and a micro-tip about productivity. Keep it upbeat.
User: "Black coffee, please."
Assistant: "Hey champ! Got you a black coffee. Tip: Pomodoro in 25s to crush that PR. ☕"
```

marco: ops-bot: can we please not actually auto-send productivity tips to users without opt-in? :sweat_smile:

ops-bot: reminder: experiments that message users require opt-in flag. see #help for guidelines.

nina: someone design a sticker: "BaristAI: Serving latte art and gentle code nudges."

sam: also new meme thread idea: take a famous LLM system prompt and replace the model with a coffee drink. e.g., "You are Espresso: concise, intense, and refuses to be verbose."

leo: tagging @design for a paddleboard of coffee-llm mascots — latte foam pompom. :art: :dog2:

marco: tiny contest: best one-liner BaristAI prompt wins a bag of beans. entries on this thread. I'll judge.

sam: entry: "You are Cold Brew. You never raise your voice but you will leave a note. Keep your replies under 12 words."

nina: entry: "You are Mocha. You soothe. You add 1 emoji to every response. Never apologize." :chocolate_bar:

leo: entry: "You are Ristretto. Speed first, context later. Provide bullet steps."

ops-bot: note: contest is internal only. please don't use vendor names in prompts.

marco: deadline end of day Friday. winner announced Monday with a sticker and beans. go! :trophy:
